literal_source_claim_zh: 几乎处处收敛与一致收敛的关系
literal_source_claim_en: The relationship between almost-everywhere convergence and uniform convergence.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not decide the domain or codomain, measure, finite-measure boundary, sequence index, function and limit measurability, exact almost-everywhere premise, exceptional-set containment and measure bound, retained set, uniform-convergence predicate, or quantifier order. domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix the measurable space, measure and finite-measure scope, function index, codomain and separation convention, all Lean universes and typeclasses, and the domain set on which convergence is asserted.
conclusion: Prospective family only: for every positive error budget, discard a measurable exceptional set of sufficiently small measure so that almost-everywhere pointwise convergence becomes uniform convergence on the retained set. The exact exceptional-set and convergence forms are open.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve empty and null working sets, zero measure, infinite global measure with a finite subset, pseudo-metric separation, index directedness, exceptional-set containment, and strict versus non-strict measure bounds.

excluded_substitutions: convergence in measure, Vitali convergence, dominated convergence, Lusin's theorem, or Borel-Cantelli in place of Egorov's theorem
a finite sequence, finite domain, constant-function case, or a premise already containing uniform convergence outside a small set
